name: Odin 2
about:
A semi-modular hybrid synthesizer with three oscillators, a flexible filter section, modulation matrix and built-in effects. Aimed at both quick sound design and deep patching.

The release builds are published under a nightly tag, so the catalog reads the version from the installer name.
notes: The only upstream release is tagged NightlyDevel and is not flagged as a pre-release, so allow_prerelease is set explicitly and the version is read from the asset name. Windows installer is Inno Setup (verified by signature).
